goal: Cross Mt Moon to Cerulean City (THIN model-authored plan).
note: subgoals copied VERBATIM from the model's own decomposition mtmoon_fresh2.json — a subset for testing, nothing added. This plan LACKS the B2F return leg (4/5 samples did); the test is whether escalation + the warp `reachable` flag discovers the transit at RUNTIME.

subgoals.goal_text: Navigate through the first floor of Mt Moon and descend to the basement (B1F).
Navigate through B1F and descend further to the lowest level (B2F).
Locate and defeat the Super Nerd guarding the fossils on B2F.
Find the exit of Mt Moon and emerge onto Route 4.
Travel across Route 4 to enter Cerulean City.
